# signal-go-gadget

signal-go-gadget

## How to use

```bash
$ go run examples/close/main.go
pid 846299
```

```bash
$ IG_EXPERIMENTAL=true sudo -E ig run ghcr.io/alban/signal-go-gadget:latest --target_pid=846299
INFO[0000] Experimental features enabled                
RUNTIME.CONTAINERNAME                                              PID                                COMM            
                                                                   850158                             main            
                                                                   850158                             main            
```
